conclusion.verdict: Deterministic synthetic double-slit profile generated by dvch_double_slit.py (not digitized Tonomura data). The source is monochromatic, so any DVCH amplitude correction is degenerate with the overall flux normalization and is not constrained by the pattern shape; no beta_eff fit was performed. Therefore DVCH and standard QM are statistically indistinguishable at the laboratory scale.
